conviction_note: The FY26 P&L was pre-released by RNS on 24 July 2026 (rev ~GBP815m, adj op profit ~GBP152m, adj PBT ~GBP167m), so the scheduled print carries almost no reported-year surprise capacity and my findings sum to only -0.9; I then shrink that to -0.6 because this name's own observed reaction distribution is strongly positive (12 of 17 RNS reactions positive, signed mean +3.45%, and BOTH prior Final Results were up: +3.94% on 2024-09-12 and +10.02% on 2025-09-18, the latter also after a pre-announcement), and because at 8 analysts and $5.2m/day this is the best-covered name in the run so every fact I have is in somebody's preview. print_vs_bar is mildly positive (the number lands on the company's own guide) while expected_move is mildly negative (the guide language will not validate the mid-teens thesis the last six sessions bought) - they disagree by design.
bar: The company's OWN pre-released FY2026 numbers, not a consensus: 'FY2026 revenue is expected to be approximately GBP815m, 14% higher than the prior year... adjusted operating profit is expected to be approximately GBP152m and adjusted profit before tax to be approximately GBP167m, 31% above the prior year' - Trading Statement RNS, 24 July 2026, https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/renishaw--rsw/trading-statement/9685234 . The forward bar is FY2027 adj PBT ~GBP186m (FY2028 ~GBP207m), sourced only from secondary UK press summarising post-July broker revisions and therefore marked snippet_only - I have capped every size accordingly.
session_check: bmo, confirmed twice from the issuer rather than the vendor: a 'Notice of Results' RNS on Investegate dated 11 Sep 2026 10:00 (https://www.investegate.co.uk/company/RSW/announcements) and Renishaw's own IR page, which states the results are announced 'on Wednesday 23 September 2026 at 07:00 BST' with the analyst presentation at 08:30 BST at Peel Hunt, 100 Liverpool Street (https://www.renishaw.com/en/register-for-the-2026-full-year-results-presentation--50202). 07:00 BST is a full hour before the 08:00 London open, so the scored window close(2026-09-22)->close(2026-09-23) is correct.
positioning_check: No disclosed net short position. The FCA aggregated register (as of 2026-09-19, 419 issuers, https://www.fca.org.uk/publication/documents/aggregated-current-net-short-positions.csv) downloaded successfully and does NOT name Renishaw, so anchor_covered is false with state register_read_no_position. That is the 0.5% truncation floor, NOT evidence that nobody is short - 0.49% and 0.00% are the same row here. There is therefore no positioning anchor on this name at all and no build/cover signal. The UK domestic record adds the complementary absence: Investegate shows NO Holding(s) in Company, TR-1, Director/PDMR Shareholding or Transaction in Own Shares RNS for RSW at any point in 2026, so there is no visible insider distribution into a stock up 56% year to date, and no buyback running.

findings.finding: The only genuinely new datum in Wednesday's print is the Q1 FY2027 current-trading line (July-September 2026, eight weeks nobody has seen), and Renishaw's exit rate into it is the strongest in its history: Q4 FY2026 revenue of approximately GBP243m, 27% above the prior year and 18% above Q3, which annualises to roughly GBP970m against an FY2027 consensus adj PBT of about GBP186m built off a materially smaller revenue number.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Renishaw's current-trading/outlook line has been the mover for this name all year and has skewed positive: Trading Statement 2026-04-20 +6.19%, Trading Statement 2026-05-06 +4.76%, Trading Statement 2026-07-24 +5.19%, and the FY25 Final Results on 2025-09-18 (which carried only a qualitative 'steady start' line) +10.02%. Across all 17 observed RNS reactions in the baseline, 12 were positive with a signed mean of +3.45%.
findings.original_quote: Record quarterly revenue in Q4 was approximately GBP243m, 27% above the prior year and 18% above Q3. All three segments delivered growth, with particularly strong progress for Specialised Technologies and Position Measurement.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q4 exit rate itself IS priced - it moved the stock +5.19% on the day. What is not priced is the eight weeks of FY2027 trading that only the company can see and that it will describe on Wednesday; no covering analyst has that. If it were priced, the sell side would have stopped at Jefferies' single upgrade rather than the stock needing a separate unexplained +5.41% on 2026-09-21 with no RNS behind it to reach a 52-week high. I size this at +0.8 rather than higher precisely BECAUSE 8 analysts at $5.2m a day of turnover have all modelled the exit rate: only the confirmation is new, not the inference.
findings.independence: Jefferies, upgrading Hold->Buy with a price target of 6,090p from 3,450p, reaches the same conclusion from outside the company: 'Semiconductor demand supporting mid-teens organic revenue growth' - https://www.thearmchairtrader.com/uk-shares/broker-tips/antofagasta-renishaw-harbour-energy-victrex-housebuilders/ (2026-09-15). Different document, different author, same direction.

findings.finding: The bull case now embedded in the price is roughly double the company's own stated ambition, and Renishaw has never used the FY-results statement to give a numeric guide: at its Capital Markets Day on 16 June 2026 management REAFFIRMED a through-cycle target of HIGH SINGLE-DIGIT revenue growth (plus >20% operating margin, >70% operating cash conversion, >15% post-tax ROIC), while the entire six-session +11.6% run-up rests on Jefferies' 'mid-teens organic revenue growth' thesis - so the outlook paragraph on Wednesday is very unlikely to validate what the buyers of the last six sessions have paid for.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The one time this name's guidance line visibly undershot what holders wanted, it was punished hard and fast: Half-year Report 2025-02-13 -11.73%, and Trading Statement 2024-05-08 -4.21%. Against that, the FY25 Final Results on 2025-09-18 carried exactly the cautious qualitative language I expect here and still rose +10.02% - which is why this is sized at -1.4 and not at the -4 low end. The FY-results outlook line is genuinely two-sided for this name; the asymmetry is the entry price, not the language.
findings.original_quote: high single-digit through-cycle revenue growth ... operating margin target of 20% or more ... operating cash conversion of more than 70% ... 15% post-tax return on invested capital
findings.why_not_priced: It is half-priced, which is why I size it small. Eight analysts can read the June CMD deck. What is not in the price is the JUXTAPOSITION: the stock closed at a 52-week high on 2026-09-21 on a broker note arguing mid-teens growth, three months after the company itself reaffirmed high single digits. If the market had reconciled those two numbers, the stock would not have added 11.6% from the 2026-09-14 close of 4,900p to the sealed 5,470p in six sessions with no company announcement of any kind in between (Investegate shows nothing for RSW between the 11 Sep Notice of Results and today). The run-up is the evidence that it is not reconciled.
findings.independence: The FY2025 Final Results RNS of 2025-09-18 is a separate primary document showing this company's habitual FY-results outlook register: 'Despite the continued global uncertainty, the structural drivers that underpin our markets are presenting growth opportunities across our businesses and at this stage we are expecting to achieve further steady revenue growth in the year ahead' and 'There has been a steady start to FY2026 in line with our expectations' - https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/renishaw--rsw/final-results/9115235 . No numeric range was given. NOTE: the CMD targets could not be verified in the primary document - Renishaw's own PDF hosting (www.renishaw.com/media/pdf/... and /resourcecentre/en/download/capital-markets-day-2026--146786) returns an IIS 10.0 500.19 error to curl, so the target figures are snippet_only on two agreeing secondary sources (Yahoo/MarketBeat above and TipRanks).

findings.finding: The stock enters the print at a 52-week high having added 10.33% in five sessions and 11.6% from the 2026-09-14 close of 4,900p, and the final and largest leg - +5.41% to 5,455p on Monday 2026-09-21 - has no identified catalyst in any source and no RNS behind it, on ordinary volume of 111,794 shares against the 591,541 traded on the 11 September upgrade day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name has not previously gone into a scheduled print at a 52-week high, so there is no matched precedent. The nearest analogue is 2025-02-13, where the shares had rallied into the interims and fell -11.73%; the counter-analogue is 2025-09-18, where a pre-announced FY result still added +10.02%.
findings.why_not_priced: Honestly: it substantially IS the price, and I have cut it from -0.7 to -0.3 for exactly that reason. anchor_covered is false on this name, so priced_lean_pct (-0.432) is 100% the run-up term, and the run-up is also the free control this stage has to out-rank - a negative finding built on the run-up cannot beat the benchmark by construction. What is left over, and is the only part I am charging for, is the shape rather than the level: the five-day move (+10.33%) exceeds the twenty-day move (+8.64%), so the position is new and held at a loss-free but very recent basis, which is the marginal seller on a low-information print.
findings.independence: The UK domestic RNS record corroborates the absence of a company cause: Investegate lists only 'Notice of Results' (11 Sep 2026 10:00) and 'Trading Statement' (24 Jul 2026 07:00) for RSW across the whole July-September window, with no Holding(s) in Company, TR-1, PDMR or Transaction in Own Shares in 2026 at all - https://www.investegate.co.uk/company/RSW/announcements . A contemporaneous wire piece also states no reason was identifiable: https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/corporate-news/renishaw-stock-heads-into-the-open-after-a-5-41-percent-rise/70151812 (2026-09-22).

outside_window.finding: The GBP50m+ Miskin (South Wales) capacity programme - 400,000 sq ft / 37,000 sq m of new low-carbon buildings, two production halls and a welfare facility, with Barnwood as main contractor - is an FY2027-28 capital-expenditure step-up against FY2026 capex planned at about GBP40m, and against a CMD target of >70% operating cash conversion. Any capex guide given on Wednesday resolves over quarters, not over one session.

Deltam Holdings Limited, the joint McMurtry/Deer family holding company formed on 2025-11-28, holds 50.25% of Renishaw and states an intention to be a long-term shareholder, which closes the 2021 strategic-review/bid optionality permanently and caps the free float at 49.75%. Settled ten months ago and not a 23 September event.

baseline_tension: It AGREES with the lean and with the run-up, which is the weakest place a finding can sit on this name: anchor_covered is false, so priced_lean_pct (-0.432) is entirely the runup term and therefore identical in kind to the free control -run_up_20d_pct that this stage must out-rank, and my two negative findings both lean on the same extended tape - so I have cut the purely positional one to -0.3 and shrunk the emitted number 0.3pp below the sum of findings to keep the caveat inside the number.

lessons_applied: 'Two findings resting on one document are one finding.' My -0.7 'FY26 is pre-announced so the print is low-information' and my +1.0 'Q4 exit rate implies a strong Q1 FY27 line' BOTH rested on the 24 July 2026 Trading Statement RNS, read in opposite directions - textbook double-counting that the sum would have netted blindly. I collapsed them: the pre-announcement moved into the `bar` field where it belongs, and one guidance finding at +0.8 survives. Findings count 4 -> 3.

'Positioning is the thing to beat, not the thing to agree with' plus 'when anchor_covered is false, priced_lean_pct is the run-up, which is also the free control.' My positioning finding was a restatement of the benchmark. Cut -0.7 -> -0.3, keeping only the part that is not the 20-day control (the front-loaded shape, 5d +10.33% > 20d +8.64%), and said so explicitly in why_not_priced.

'Coverage tells you which regime you are in... at >13 an English search returns their preview.' analyst_band is 8-13 at $5.2m/day - the well-covered regime, and by far the best-covered name in today's run. Haircut the CMD-vs-Jefferies guidance finding -1.6 -> -1.4, because eight covering analysts can all read the June deck; only the unreconciled juxtaposition is mine.

'Understatement is the hunters' systematic error. Size on the name's own reaction distribution.' The distribution here is positively skewed (12 of 17 positive, signed mean +3.45%, both prior Final Results up), so the lesson cut the other way from usual: it did not make me larger, it made me less negative and much wider. Bands widened to [-4.0, +0.3] on the guidance finding and [0.0, +3.0] on the positive one.

'The hunter's own caveat has to reach the number.' baseline_tension says my evidence agrees with the lean and the run-up, so expected_move (-0.6) is held visibly inside the sum of findings (-0.9), a 0.3pp shrink, and the note states the amount and the reason.

'The UK's [pre-release channel] is an RNS trading update, given the 217-day median gap between scheduled releases. Check before sizing anything on the quarter.' Done, and it is the whole structure of this name: the 24 July statement carried the FY26 P&L, so print_vs_bar is +0.5 rather than anything sized off the 4.76% median reaction.

'Keep findings inside the exit window.' Moved the GBP50m+ Miskin capex programme and the Deltam 50.25% holding out of findings and into outside_window - both are real and sourced and neither resolves on 23 September.
